features.name: Expense Agent
features.description: An AI agent for handling expense processing that will be available this year. Users can snap receipts with their phone and the system processes them automatically.

features.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Integration
features.description: Integration of Business Central with 365 Copilot to access AI capabilities, including integration with Microsoft Graph for mail, calendar, Teams and other M365 tools.
caveats: Consumer versions of tools like ChatGPT do not provide enterprise capabilities

features.name: Natural Language Invoice Processing
features.description: Users can upload an invoice and the system automatically processes it, with option for user correction or specific conversation handling rather than manual field-by-field data entry.
caveats: This represents a future vision of how users will interact with the system

features.name: AI-Enhanced Payables Processing
features.description: AI capabilities for reducing costs in expense and payables workflows as part of the broader AI integration strategy.

features.name: AI-Driven Business Growth Capabilities
features.description: Beyond cost reduction, AI enables companies to do things they never imagined, such as creating visualizations and building new business scenarios that would otherwise be too costly.

features.name: UI Evolution with AI-Enabled Workflows
features.description: Significant changes in user interaction paradigm combining natural language with traditional UI, reducing time spent in data entry and navigation within the application.
caveats: Strong commitment to maintain and improve the Business Central UI rather than replacing it

features.name: Interactions from External Tools
features.description: Business Central interactions will increasingly happen from other tools people use such as Teams, Outlook, M365, and ambient interfaces rather than within the application.
caveats: Pace and rate of adoption unclear
ERP data accuracy requirements may slow adoption
